root: ^She stands with arms crossed, her gaze steady, analyzing you before speaking.

^You’re awake. Good. My name is Sofia and I'm the leader in town. Her tone is even, professional, but there’s something heavy beneath it. I won’t waste time. We found you unconscious last night—beside our neighbor Sheila’s body. Do you understand what that means?

^She waits for a reaction, then continues, her voice firm. Right now, you are the only suspect. The town is demanding justice. If we don’t find the real killer by the end of the day, they will execute you. She lets the words settle, her expression unreadable.
^I don’t want that to happen. So listen carefully—I’m giving you a chance. Find proof of who really did this, and I will make sure you walk away from this town alive.
^She takes a deep breath, then hands you a <color=#c30010>JOURNAL</color>.
^Start with this. I’ve written down what we know so far—the people in town, their roles, and what little we understand of Sheila’s death. It’s not much, but it’s a start
^Oh! and one last thing, make sure to speak with Judy she has a MAP you can use, you will need it before leaving the town. You can find her near in front of the library. Good luck Kerlosch.
